job.name: ig26_host
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: психолог ~50: рыжевато-каштановые кудри до плеч, очки на голове, пудрово-розовая блуза, кресло цвета бутылочного стекла, светлая гостиная
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a charismatic, witty Russian woman psychologist about 50 with shoulder-length curly auburn-chestnut hair, reading glasses pushed up on her head, light makeup, a dusty-pink blouse, small gold earrings, sitting in a bottle-green velvet armchair, hands relaxed in her lap. A knowing, slightly mischievous expression. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 18% below the upper edge (leave calm empty wall above her head for a title), looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO broad smile. Background: a bright home living room with a warm white wall, a framed still life painting and a plant, blurred. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
